title: local-offload gate input
description: The document `local-offload gate verdict --input` reads: one comparison of a candidate arm against the incumbent arm under a frozen baseline. Stamps come from the runs that produced the scores. An unresolved efficiency value is JSON null (or an absent key) and is never read as 0. Scores of pass and task_fail attempts must lie in the baseline's primary class range (unit_interval: 0..1, judge_0_10: 0..10, custom: the range the baseline froze). Efficiency values are finite and not below 0. The judge must be the one the baseline froze. The Go gate refuses what this schema cannot express (task ids outside the baseline's declared list, a repeated task id, an incumbent that differs from the baseline's frozen one, a judge other than the frozen one).

baseline_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the frozen baseline file this input was produced under.

incumbent.description: The incumbent arm. Required unless the baseline froze one; when both are present they must be equal.

receipt.description: The self-test receipt of a model judge. Required (and must be passed, for the same scorer) when judge.kind is model.

outcome.description: What happened to one attempt. pass, task_fail and cheat are scored (a cheat enters at the worst score of the primary range); every other class is counted and never scored: a candidate's enters its task's mean at the worst score, an incumbent's is skipped.

score.description: Required for pass and task_fail. A cheat enters at the worst score of the primary range whatever it carries; ignored for every other class.

metrics.description: Efficiency values by declared metric name (tokens, money, memory in GiB): finite and not below 0. null or an absent key means unresolved.

identity.description: The scorer id: a deterministic scorer's name, or the model id. It must be the judge the baseline froze (kind and identity); a model judge's receipt must name the same scorer.

pairs_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the pairs the self-test ran on.

build_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the build that ran the self-test.
